result:
The candidate does everything the work order asks, and I found no blocking problems. The verdict is FINDINGS only because of one advisory gap that the base commit has too.

```
VERDICT: FINDINGS
CANDIDATE: 4265b71501958ce30407eebc76ebe2b638f0a186
FINDING text-shortened-to-cut advisory: if a stored text value is longer than 10,000 characters and the source value later becomes exactly its first 10,000 characters, the change is never written. The list value then equals the desired value, and the work order only asks for a single read when the desired value is longer than 10,000. This is not a regression: the base commit also does not write the Email body in this case (base writes on that run: Opportunity, Task, Meeting descriptions and Email cc/from/to/usersIds, but no body/bodyPlain). It falls outside the work order's rule, and the candidate's own test treats exactly 10,000 as "never re-read". | evidence: scratch test test_body_truncated_by_source_to_10000 (load with a 17,318-character body, then re-run with TextBody[:10000]) -> "Lists differ: [] != [('Email', ['body', 'bodyPlain'])]" | expected: the shortened body is written. Accepting the gap is fine. Closing it would mean a single read whenever a list value is exactly 10,000 characters and differs from the stored full value, which is rare. The PL decides whether to accept it or open a follow-up.
EVIDENCE:
- HEAD of /srv/CRM/worktrees/CRM-009-I is 4265b71501958ce30407eebc76ebe2b638f0a186 and is the same at the end. `git status --porcelain --ignored` shows nothing, so the worktree was not changed.
- Suites run as uid 1002 (forgev2-pl), non-root:
  - `PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -I -B -m unittest discover -s tests/load -t .`: Ran 223, OK.
  - `python3 -B -m unittest discover -s tests/unit`: Ran 561, OK.
  - tests/acceptance needs a running stack and credentials (`ConfigError: CRM_ADMIN_USERNAME ... must be set`). Not run, as instructed.
- Allowlist: the diff touches only docs/IMPORT.md, load/lib/crm_load/engine.py, tests/load/fixtures.py and tests/load/test_load.py. mapping.py is unchanged.
- Data, secrets and IPs: the added lines contain no IPs, secrets or tokens. The only addresses are on the reserved example.test and x.test domains.
- Code reading:
  - Create path: the create body, the WriteRejected→exception code mapping and the retries are unchanged.
  - Email.usersIds is still sent on create (my probe shows usersIds in the POST body).
  - `_single` is cached per record in the `single` dict, so there is at most one `GET {Entity}/{id}` per upsert. The phone read (CRM-008-F) uses the same cache.
  - `client.get` still raises `read_failed` when the read fails.
- Non-vacuity: the new TestCrm009I tests run against the base engine (base engine with the candidate's tests and fake) give 4 of 5 FAIL (zero-writes re-run, users not propagated, real differences, same_value rules).
- Mutation run on a scratch copy (mutate.py, full load suite each time); every mutation was caught:
  - M1 CREATE_ONLY={}: 35 fail
  - M2 no untruncate: 3 fail
  - M2b no prefix check: test_real_differences_are_updated fails
  - M2c one read per attribute: test_rerun_zero_writes fails
  - M3a to/cc exact: 35 fail
  - M3b from exact: 36 fail
  - M3c to/cc always equal: 2 fail
  - M3d from always equal: 2 fail
- My own probes (scratch test_tester.py on the candidate): 14 of 15 pass.
  - A change at character 10,000 of a 17,318-character body: one Email read, then a PUT of body and bodyPlain.
  - A change at character 9,999 (not a prefix): a PUT with no single read.
  - A body extended past the stored value: written, and the next re-run makes 0 writes.
  - A Contact with two phones and a 15,000-character description: exactly one Contact read, and 0 writes on the re-run.
  - A re-run of an unchanged snapshot sends GET requests only.
  - A cc that adds an address, with the other addresses differing in case: PUT `{"cc": "c@example.test;AA@example.test;new@x.test"}`, which is the mapped value.
  - cc removed entirely: PUT `{"cc": null}`.
  - CREATE_ONLY covers Email only, so Meeting usersIds is still compared.
  - The only failure is the advisory finding above.
- A2 (re-running the crm-beta load with 0 updates) is an operator step. I could not run it here: no network and no containers.
- Processes: I started no servers and no containers. No python processes were left running.
```
